name: create_danmaku_report
description: Persist a private HTML report for the frozen report request; this tool makes no additional model calls. Choose the evidence path: VIDEO-only sources require the video evidence_id alone, with no feedback query. Feedback reports require the feedback evidence_id: query_danmaku classification uses topic_key T1..T6; query_audience classification uses T1..T100, even when only one text source was selected. Both allow reserved OTHER only with title 其他讨论. For a nonempty full-feedback batch, submit the returned current offset and topics_json (an array or {"topics":[...]}), with topic_key, title, observation, recommendation and sample_ids. Submit at most 10 topics and no more topics than current groups; omit old topics with no current members. Aim to assign every returned representative G ID exactly once; sample_ids are all members, not examples. The server ignores empty-member topics and keeps duplicate members in their first topic. Omitted members join the first submitted nonempty topic titled 其他讨论, preserving its key; only if none exists does the server create OTHER. Follow the actual returned classification.topics keys across batches; do not rename a T-key fallback to OTHER. Unknown IDs, invalid keys or wrong offsets are rejected; correct the current batch, never replay an accepted batch. Reuse topic keys and update prose without forgetting earlier conclusions. Only when VIDEO is selected, supply video_evidence_id for the same video; at least one first-batch topic must connect to actual frames via video_context and video_at_ms, an integer array of 1-4 actual sampled positions (example: [1320]). Attribute audio claims to viewers unless supported by audio evidence. Exact duplicate expressions are compressed with source, author role, playback position and reply context preserved; submit representative IDs and the server expands coverage. A batch has at most 40 distinct expressions, not 40 raw records. Intermediate calls save progress and return the next batch; the last complete batch validates coverage, persists HTML and delivers the report. Classification progress alone is not a stored report; no extra model merge is needed. For zero feedback, omit topics_json and offset: pass feedback evidence_id alone when VIDEO is unselected, or feedback evidence_id plus video_evidence_id when VIDEO is selected. Legacy sampled evidence without audience uses sections_json with up to 6 sections and 1-4 existing sample IDs per section. Read the active report Skill for analysis guidance.

evidence_id.description: For feedback reports, use the feedback evidence_id returned by query_danmaku/query_audience. Only for VIDEO-only reports, use the video evidence_id instead; not an artifact ID or a historical run result.

sections_json.description: Legacy sampled evidence without audience only: JSON string of up to 6 sections with title, observation, recommendation and 1-4 existing sample_ids each. Omit for full-feedback and VIDEO-only reports.

offset.description: Full-feedback classification position: copy the latest classification.offset (initially 0), not the number of weighted messages or compressed input rows. Omit for zero feedback and VIDEO-only reports.

topics_json.description: Nonempty full-feedback batch classification as a JSON string (array or {"topics":[...]}). Follow the active report Skill and current representative G IDs; this is not native JSON objects or HTML. Omit for zero feedback and VIDEO-only reports.

video_evidence_id.description: Same-run, same-video evidence_id from analyze_video_content for feedback reports selecting VIDEO. Supply it on the first classification (also for zero feedback); the accepted draft retains it. Omit when VIDEO is unselected; VIDEO-only reports use evidence_id instead.
